notes:
Summary: VervePoint is an ecommerce customer-support platform evaluating Redwood for a staged RAG deployment focused on embeddings + reranking to drive ticket deflection. They ingest historical tickets (CRM + email + chat) and want a low-latency reranker for top-5 quality.

Firmographics / constraints:
- HQ: Seattle, servicing NA + EU merchants.
- Dataset: ~3.2M historical support messages (tickets, threads, KB) to index; expect growth 10% q/q.
- Must keep customer data in regional clouds (US + EU); vendor must support residency.
- SSO + audit logs required for agents.

Technical requirements / KPIs:
- Workloads: embeddings store + ANN search, then neural reranker for top-5 reordering. Primary flow is query -> embed -> ANN -> rerank -> return top-5.
- Indexing scale target: 2-5M docs in first phase, up to 10M in 12 months.
- Latency SLOs: reranker p95 <= 150ms for deflection path; end-to-end p95 (query->reply) <= 300ms for agent suggestions.
- Throughput: 250 qps during peak for search layer (burst to 800 qps).
- Quality target: top-5 precision >= 85% for deflectable ticket suggestions; product lead says "we need the top-5 so good we can auto-close 40-60% of low-complexity tickets".
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost per query <= $0.02 (embeddings + ANN + rerank) for baseline POC.
- Model prefs: open-weights Llama3-like quantized candidates for reranker; embedding model evaluated against in-house baseline (768-d vectors).
- Routing/fallback: prefer dedicated capacity for reranking; fallback to hosted smaller model in congestion.

Security / compliance:
- Require SOC2 compliance and SSO/SAML integration (Okta).
- KMS integration for customer keys; audit logging for query traces retained 90 days.
- Must pass legal redaction check; asked about on-prem or private plane for regulated merchants.

POC scope and milestones:
- Milestone 1 (2 weeks): ingest 3 months of tickets (~600k docs), verify embedding pipeline, measure cold/hot index build times.
- Milestone 2 (2 weeks): run 50k synthetic queries against ANN + reranker; collect latency and top-5 precision metrics.
- Milestone 3 (1 week): cost sweep across batch sizes, quantization profiles; provide cost per query scenarios and recommended config.
- Accept criteria: reranker p95 <= 150ms and top-5 precision >=85% on held-out test set; cost per query <= $0.02 target or roadmap to reach within 6 months.

Sales notes / quotes:
- AE: Maya Chen — focus on mid-market contract with option to move to Dedicated.
- SE: Rafael Ortiz — leading POC configs and embedding tuning.
- PM (VervePoint): "Latency is make-or-break. If p95 slips beyond ~200ms, agents won't adopt suggestions."

Next steps (short):
- Deliver POC plan + estimate by 2026-03-14 (Rafael).
- Security questionnaire follow-up and legal template request (Priya).
- Schedule cost sweep run (2 days) and reranker baseline (1 week).
